issues.issue: The draft states that the front-of-pack must list the full ingredient list, but the source fact specifies 'ingredient_list_carton' without requiring it to be placed on the front of the pack.

The draft describes 250g, 480g, and 1000g as serving sizes to be included on the nutrition panel, whereas the source lists the product serving size as 85 (with 8 servings per container) and identifies 250g, 480g, and 1000g only as 'nutrition_serving_sizes_evaluated'.
The BPN code 'DF-BERRY-480G-US' is omitted from the packaging requirements.
The storage instructions in the draft omit the mandatory requirement to 'eat within a month or by date shown, for best before, see base of pack'.
